description: Four-stage moderation evidence for original-source news images. A source-hosted image is never reusable merely because it is publicly visible.

gates.question: Is the candidate image hosted/published by the verified primary source and traceable to the exact source page?
Does the image represent the reported project/event/company without misleading substitution?
Is reuse by IIG supported by explicit license/permission or other documented rights basis? Public visibility alone is FAIL.
Does the asset meet safe URL/file, availability, format, dimensions/crop and rendering requirements?

decision: ORIGINAL_SOURCE_IMAGE only when G1..G4 all PASS; otherwise SAME_SECTOR_IIG_FALLBACK
